patch_description: Replace constant mutation width with a smoothed exploration target. Lower fitness and stalled progress increase exploration; strong fitness reduces mutation width for refinement. A drop in archive fitness relative to remembered population fitness temporarily raises exploration without requiring task identifiers or a switch schedule. Archive-relative offspring success provides a small secondary adjustment, rather than being treated as parent-matched success. Four memory values track smoothed mean fitness, best fitness, stagnation, and initialization. This is an untested proposal.
